posts.en:
dsh-depguard is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f01a37926dfe13df62b8.html
